result.summary: Found 3 issues: one major issue with a stuck loading spinner overlaying content, and two minor layout issues with truncated elements.

issues.description: A loading spinner is rendered on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image and appears stuck, since the rest of the page has fully loaded. It obscures the restaurant image and looks like a broken or unfinished load state.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image loads, or investigate why the spinner is not being dismissed. Ensure image loading states resolve correctly.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, truncating the name and image.
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable for a horizontal carousel, but consider adding a subtle peek/cut-off indicator or partial fade to signal that the row is scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter chips row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip sliver, which may look like a rendering glitch.
issues.suggestion: Add a scroll affordance (e.g., partial chip visibility is intentional, but consider a fade-out gradient) to indicate horizontal scrolling.
